title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Equal time or earned time
hook: Before the next game, look at last game's innings.
intro: The game is close in the last inning.
Two kids on the bench have barely played.
statement: Playing time tells kids what you value.
q1: Do you give every player equal innings —
q2: or let practice effort earn more time?
q3: At what age should that start to change?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids accept the rules
t2: when they know them before the game starts.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle playing time?
ctaLines: Equal innings. A rotation chart. Effort counts.
Does it change as kids get older?
ctaPrompt: Share your playing time habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Before the next game, look at last game's innings.
The game is close in the last inning. Two kids on the bench have barely played.
Playing time tells kids what you value.
Equal innings or earned innings. There is no perfect answer.
How do you handle playing time? Share your habit in the comments.
